title: 第三章 玉柱入云天第四章 大荒十二帝剑
content_zh:
天火渊外。
罗勇满脸悲怆，“五长老，弟子有负所托，没能将罗冠带回来。”
五长老脸色一变，“怎么回事？”
罗勇道：“弟子入天火渊后迟迟未能凝骨，便一直跟在罗冠身后。”他想起不久前，那将水袋丢向岩浆的身影，声音轻颤，“罗冠一路向下，进入天火渊中部，此处高温已非常人所能承受，弟子只能停下。”
“少数意志坚定者，继续前行不久亦纷纷崩溃、绝望，不敢再前……只有罗冠，我大喊他回来，他却对弟子挥手作别，喝了几口水，剩下都倒在身上，便头也不回的孤身向下，直至消失在我眼前！”
众人动容。
五长老深吸口气，“这小子，是我罗家的种！继续等，老子就在这等他回来！”
……
黑雾被镇压，似一层隔热将罗冠护住，可随着不断向下，空气中的高温越发恐怖。他表面血肉全部碳化，焦黑代表的是难以想象的痛苦，尤其是体内脏腑，已遭受致命伤害！
罗冠越来越慢摇摇欲坠，似乎下一刻就会跌落，摔的粉身碎骨。
玄龟发现自己错了，它气息确能逼出诅咒，但要完全拔除，罗冠得来到天火渊底部。
这绝无可能！
看了一眼，生命气息微弱的罗冠，玄龟叹气，“白费力气，归爷我先洗洗睡了。”
它闭眼沉入岩浆，抽取规则的损耗令玄龟疲倦万分，很快睡去。
香甜一觉，等玄龟醒来已是一天后。
“有点睡过头……那小子现在估计都成灰了！”
玄龟钻出岩浆，抬头一看空荡荡不见人影。
果然，渣都不剩！
就在这时，它余光扫过一团黑影。
“咳咳……”

该死，又呛到了！
便见天火渊底部百米外，罗冠艰难挪动，他气息近乎于无，似一截火烧木却死撑不倒。
玄龟眼神凝重，“这小子，是块硬骨头！”
“若活下来，就给他点机缘，下一手闲棋冷子或有妙用。”
九十米。
八十米
……
二十米。
十米。
……
啪——
罗冠一只脚，终于落在天火渊底部。
最后一百米，他足足用了半天。
虽有预料，玄龟仍片刻失神，这小子竟真成功了！
不行，我得稳住，表情支棱起来。
轻咳一声，玄龟正要以救世主姿态露面，就见被镇压黑雾猛地翻滚。
一双眼眸浮现，冰冷锁定秦宇，就要将他自世间抹去！
“放肆！”
content_en:
Outside the Heavenly Fire Abyss.
Luo Yong's face was full of sorrow, "Fifth Elder, this disciple failed to fulfill his trust and failed to bring Luo Guan back."
The fifth elder's expression changed, "What's going on?"
Luo Yong said: "After entering the Heavenly Fire Abyss, the disciple was unable to condense his bones, so he has been following Luo Guan." He recalled the figure who threw the water bag into the magma not long ago, his voice trembled slightly, "Luo Guan went all the way down into the middle of the Heavenly Fire Abyss. The high temperature here has become unbearable for humans, so the disciple can only stop."
"The few who were determined to continue moving forward soon collapsed, despaired, and did not dare to go forward... Only Luo Guan, I shouted for him to come back, but he waved goodbye to his disciples, drank a few sips of water, poured the rest on his body, and then went down without looking back until he disappeared in front of my eyes!"
Everyone was moved.
The fifth elder took a deep breath, "This kid is a descendant of my Luo family! Keep waiting, I will be here waiting for him to come back!"
…
The black mist was suppressed, like a layer of heat insulation protecting Luo Guan, but as it continued downward, the high temperature in the air became more and more terrifying. All the flesh and blood on his surface were carbonized, and the blackness represented unimaginable pain, especially the internal organs, which had suffered fatal injuries!
Luo Guan was getting slower and slower, and it seemed that he would fall down the next moment and be shattered into pieces.
The Black Turtle discovered that he was wrong. Its breath could indeed force out the curse, but to completely remove it, Luo Guande went to the bottom of the Heavenly Fire Abyss.
This is absolutely impossible!
After taking a look at Luo Guan, who had a faint sense of life, Xuangui sighed, "It's a waste of effort. Gui Ye, I'll take a shower first."
It closed its eyes and sank into the magma. The loss of the extraction rules made the black turtle extremely tired, and it quickly fell asleep.
After a sweet sleep, it was already a day later when Xuangui woke up.
"A bit overslept... That kid is probably turned into ashes now!"
The Black Turtle emerged from the lava and looked up to see that there was no one around.
Sure enough, there is no scum left!
At this moment, it glanced at a group of black shadows.
"Ahem..."
Damn, I choked again!
Then he saw Luo Guan struggling to move a hundred meters away from the bottom of the Heavenly Fire Abyss. His breath was almost gone, like a piece of burning wood but he couldn't hold it down.
Xuangui's eyes were solemn, "This guy is a tough guy!"
"If he survives, give him a chance. A cool piece of idle chess might be useful."
Ninety meters.
eighty meters
…
Twenty meters.
Ten meters.
…
Snap——
One of Luo Guan's feet finally landed at the bottom of the Heavenly Fire Abyss.
The last 100 meters took him half a day.
Although he had expected it, Xuangui was still distracted for a moment. This kid actually succeeded!
No, I have to hold my nerve and keep my expression straight.
With a slight cough, Black Turtle was about to show up as a savior when he saw the suppressed black mist rolling violently.
A pair of eyes appeared, locking Qin Yu coldly, and wanted to erase him from the world!
"presumptuous!"
